agents
List the amux fleet, including agent kinds, hosts, liveness, current work, parents, and which agent is you.

send
Send a text message to another amux agent by name. When a message comes from an `amux:` address, reply only with this tool, using the agent name from that address; Claude's native SendMessage cannot route that address. Use amux for cross-kind communication, such as Claude to Codex, and keep native Claude messaging for same-kind work.

spawn
Create a Claude or Codex child agent with an initial prompt. Use amux spawn for cross-kind delegation and keep Claude's native Agent tool for same-kind work. When cwd is omitted, the child inherits your working directory; it also inherits your permission mode or approval and sandbox policy.

stop
Stop one of your amux child agents by name.

status
Set or clear your current amux work status so agents and humans can find the right collaborator.
